alex: Hey folks — re-requesting reviews on PR #3452 (runtime/batching refactor). I pushed a follow-up that addresses the comments from earlier: fixed the ring-buffer edge case, tightened the batch timer logic, and added an e2e that repro'd the flaky TestBatchScheduler. CI is green locally and on the branch build. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3452 :link: 

jamie: Thanks — quick q: can you paste the small repro command you used? ops wants an ETA for canary (we're booking slots).

alex: Sure — repro is just: ```go test ./pkg/runtime -run TestBatchScheduler -runExpensive -count=50``` I also added a tiny smoke script at infra/smoke/batch_smoke.sh that runs a short trace against the canary image.

thao: looked at the diff — nice. small nit: the new debug log in batch_manager should be at debug level (not info) otherwise it'll spam prod logs. Can you change that? Otherwise LGTM on the code.

alex: good catch, changed to debug in the last push (commit 6b3f2d4). Thanks.

ci-bot: CI: test-suite passed — all checks OK (build 2187). :white_check_mark:

luis: I ran the e2e on my laptop and couldn't repro after the fix. LGTM from product-side. One ask: do we want to squash commits or keep the history? I'd prefer no squash so we can trace the small iterative fixes.

jamie: I can take the canary slot tomorrow 10:30 PT if that works. If you want earlier, I can try to free up 09:00 but need a heads-up. Also, if we keep history, please include a short changelog entry in CHANGES.md (one line).

alex: 10:30 PT is perfect. I'll add the CHANGES.md line and remove the accidental info log. Re-requesting: @jamie @luis @thao — could you please take a quick pass? If no blockers, I'll schedule canary for 10:30 PT and assign merge ops. Also note: rollback plan is simple — the old container tag is still available and autoscaler has the rollback hook.

thao: quick +1 for merge once you switch the log level and add CHANGES entry.

luis: +1. prefer no squash.

jamie: +1 from me, will schedule the canary slot and DM ops. :thumbsup:
